summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 204410 (Opsumit/macitentan). The Summary Review's section 8 'Advisory Committee Meeting' states 'Not applicable' (L107) and the Medical Review's section 9.3 'Advisory Committee Meeting' states 'Not recommended.' (L896). The only advisory-committee reference in the review documents is to a general December 2012 Drug Safety and Risk Management (DSaRM) Advisory Committee meeting on teratogenic drugs, which was not convened for this application but was cited by the Risk review as the basis for designing the Opsumit REMS to enroll all females; no application-specific AC concern-to-change linkage exists.
